feeds.title: SF Marin Food Bank Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin.We envision a community where everyone is able to obtain enough nutritious food - in a dignified manner and to support the health and well-being of themselves and their families.

feeds.title: Greater Chicago Food Depository Blog
feeds.description: Our blog aims to inform, uplift and inspire our allies in the mission to end hunger. Follow along with new and noteworthy developments as we work to end hunger. Find the latest news updates and press releases from the Food Depository here. The Greater Chicago Food Depository is Chicago's food bank. We provide food and hope for Chicago and Cook County. Find food and get involved.

feeds.title: Daily Bread Food Bank Blog
feeds.description: Working on long-term solutions to poverty while providing food to 200 food programs across Toronto. Because hunger does not wait for policy change.

feeds.title: Houston Food Bank
feeds.description: The Houston Food Bank distributes food and other essentials to those in need through a network of 1,500 community partners. In addition, it also provides programs and services aimed at helping families achieve long-term stability including nutrition education, job training, health management, and help in securing state-funded assistance.

feeds.title: San Diego Food Bank
feeds.description: The Jacobs & Cushman San Diego Food Bank is the largest hunger-relief organization in San Diego County. It provides nutritious food to people in need, advocates for the hungry, and educates the public about hunger-related issues. Learn more and find out how you can help the San Diego Food Bank.

feeds.title: Food Bank of the Southern Tier Blog
feeds.description: The Food Bank of the Southern Tiers goal is to work together to build and sustain hunger-free communities throughout the Southern Tier of New York. We proudly serve the people of Broome, Chemung, Schuyler, Steuben, Tioga & Tompkins Counties each day. Read the various articles and posts in the Food Bank of the Southern Tier blog, including the latest news in hunger advocacy and Food Bank happenings.

feeds.title: Capital Area Food Bank Blog
feeds.description: The Capital Area Food serves the entire Washington, DC, metropolitan region, providing meals to thousands of people a day while also addressing the root causes of hunger.

feeds.title: Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
feeds.description: The Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano need your help to provide meals. Check out the work they are doing to end hunger!

feeds.title: Food Bank of Delaware Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to provide nutritious foods to Delawareans in need and facilitate long-term solutions to the problems of hunger and poverty through community education and advocacy. Stay Connected to the Food Bank of Delaware for ways to help, exciting news, and events!

feeds.title: Chester County Food Bank Blog
feeds.description: The Chester County Food Bank was formed in 2009 to address the escalating hunger problem in the county. Our primary goal was, and still is, to have a viable, sustainable organization that secures, manages and distributes food to those in need.

feeds.title: The Food Bnak Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1972, Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County was the first food bank in California and is the second oldest in the nation. Our mission is to end hunger through healthy food, education, and leadership.

feeds.title: St. Louis Area Foodbank Blog
feeds.description: St. Louis Area Foodbank's mission is to build stronger communities by empowering people with food and hope. We are here to create a stronger, healthier bi-state region where no one goes to bed hungry. Follow us to stay up to date.

feeds.title: Gleaners Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is simple and direct: To lead the fight against hunger. We do this by distributing food to hungry Hoosiers through a network of over 250 partner agencies in 21 counties, including emergency food pantries, soup kitchens and shelters.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Food banks
feeds.description: Latest news and features from theguardian.com, the worlds leading liberal voice. Follow and get latest updates and news related to Food banks.

feeds.title: FoodBank SBC
feeds.description: The Foodbank of Santa Barbara County is ending hunger and transforming the health of Santa Barbara County through good nutrition. We serve the community as a leader and expert in improving the nutritional health of our county through increased food security.

feeds.title: Parkdale Food Centre
feeds.description: At the Parkdale Food Centre, we believe in an Ottawa where everyone has the means and opportunity to live a healthy, connected, and fulfilling life.

feeds.title: The Conversation » Food banks
feeds.description: Browse Food banks news, research and analysis from The Conversation. Follow for more information.

feeds.title: Second Harvest Of The Greater Valley
feeds.description: Second Harvest of the Greater Valley fights hunger by providing healthy food, education, and leadership within our community. Follow our blog to get the most recent updates and news about food and resources for everyone.
